title: Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents

layout.note: Three rounded frames: A (wide, top left) over B (wide, bottom left), and C (tall, right) with the scatter plot; each frame has a coloured pill header carrying its letter, peach, blue-grey and pink.

lesson: For a paper with three deliverables, give each its own framed panel under a colour-coded lettered pill: an icon chain for the environment, cartoon characters with props for the attack strategies, and one scatter plot with two coloured trend lines for the headline result.
